long_biography.plain_text:
Rohde & Liesenfeld was a family-owned Hamburg freight forwarder when Bodo Liesenfeld joined in 1980. Over the next 27 years, largely as managing director, he helped develop a network of 65 offices spanning every continent. By the 2007 sale to Geodis, he was the company's sole owner; industry reporting valued the transaction at €77 million.

Following the sale, Liesenfeld established Liesenfeld International to invest on both sides of the Atlantic. He later co-founded Anthemion Senior Lifestyles and its specialist memory-care residence, The Cordwainer, in Massachusetts. His public work has included representing Hamburg in the north-eastern United States, chairing the German Latin America Association and serving on Berklee College of Music advisory bodies.
